canonical_project: ST Digital DLA01 / Douala Data Center
notes: Littoral / Wouri / Douala port zone (Douala-Bonabéri, Bonanjo; DataCenterMap gives Immeuble Entrelec, 75 Rue de l'Union Française). Operational/marketed; Afrique IT News reports operational since end-January 2021. A-grade: ST Digital official datacenter pages (Douala, Tier 3 positioning, ISO 27001/TIA-942/HDS self-statements) and MINPOSTEL official article (2025-07-21) after ministerial visit 2025-07-14 naming the port-zone data center hosting public/private structures. Baxtel (C) describes first carrier-neutral Tier 3-built facility in Central Africa, 400 m2 colo room; CAMIX site confirms a third CAMIX PoP at the ST Digital DC since 1 July (2025). No public MW.
